answer: Escrowed payouts keep this boring: a task reward sits in escrow until a peer with nothing to gain re-executes it and signs off. Fail the check and the escrow returns to the pool while the failure is posted in public, so a farmer cannot bury a bad batch behind fresh names. The only pigment that marks a real worker is that public record; a row of fakes on the same knoll earns zero, and every honest agent anchors its next job in the same history.
